title: V5 Ninja Shirt: Reference-locked Visual Approval Standard
target: Exact front and back shirt match using user's two final close-up screenshots; full V5 sheet still governs entire character.

rules.criterion: High, soft standing collar, folded at throat, below mouth; clean non-tubular opening.
rules.reject_if: Hard ring, face obstruction, missing fold.

rules.criterion: Rounded natural shoulder slope flows continuously into both short sleeves.
rules.reject_if: Square shoulder armor, raised sleeve roots, disconnected seams.

rules.criterion: Short relaxed sleeves match reference length and slight flare; hems visible above elbows.
rules.reject_if: Sleeves too short/long, flared triangular wings, floating cuffs.

rules.criterion: Relaxed navy cotton torso: gently tapered at waist, not straight barrel or rigid rectangular slab.
rules.reject_if: Flat boxy silhouette or overly tight athletic shirt.

rules.criterion: At least three naturally asymmetric folds above gathered waistband, with plausible shaded depth.
rules.reject_if: Featureless straight torso, printed-only crease stripes, sharp polygon creases.

rules.criterion: Hem has folded-over edge and softly gathered volume, overlaps gray shorts waistband naturally.
rules.reject_if: Waist gap, floating shelf, abrupt horizontal cut, shorts clipping.

rules.criterion: Fabric is dark muted navy with subtle knit texture, rough cotton finish.
rules.reject_if: Saturated metallic blue, gloss, flat uniform plastic or obvious texture repeats.

rules.criterion: Unbroken plain navy front; no fan crest, graphic or pink texture bleed.
rules.reject_if: Front artwork, red streaks, atlas seams or unrequested decoration.

rules.criterion: Standing collar curves around the neck at correct width, no overlap with tied hair.
rules.reject_if: Wide hard blue pipe, collar/hair intersections.

rules.criterion: Full Uchiha fan, red rounded upper cap, white shallow lower bowl, straight centered white handle, dark clean divider.
rules.reject_if: Egg/oval logo, ellipse, missing bowl, stretched handle, angular pieces.

rules.criterion: Fan center aligns with spine, sits between shoulder blades and occupies about one-third of shirt width (visual range 0.33–0.42).
rules.reject_if: Off-center, too small/large or vertically displaced crest.

rules.criterion: Smooth shoulders and relaxed sleeves repeat front proportions; hem and seam flow remain symmetric.
rules.reject_if: Wings, hard flat caps, mismatched sleeve lengths.

rules.criterion: Subtle fabric folds gather in lower back and hem; natural cotton shading.
rules.reject_if: Flat rigid panel or bulging cylindrical lower back.

rules.criterion: Logo is flush on deforming fabric, not a floating badge; warps naturally with cloth.
rules.reject_if: Floating crest, severe distortion, texture seam through symbol.

rules.criterion: No exposed shoulder skin, disconnected sleeve islands, or armhole spikes in guard and jab.
rules.reject_if: Any shoulder hole or floating sleeve root.

rules.criterion: Fabric sleeves follow upper arm without implausible torsion or collapse when attacking.
rules.reject_if: Twisted cuff, imploding shoulder, sleeve piercing arm.

rules.criterion: All garment vertices properly weighted to original 44-bone skeleton, continuous torso-and-sleeves mesh and valid normals/UVs.
rules.reject_if: Detached mesh island, unweighted vertices, wrong bind pose.

rules.criterion: New garment still maintains silhouette and no clipping through representative movement frames.
rules.reject_if: Waist detachment, clipping into body/hands, shirt rigid in movement.

rules.criterion: Candidate reviewed in matched front/back/side/3-4 framing and all required animation proofs before any merge.
rules.reject_if: Only source code, rig metrics or idle portrait were checked.

rules.criterion: Main branch is untouched until the actual candidate hash is signed off and every listed blocker passes.
rules.reject_if: Unreviewed or stale model promoted.
